controls.name: Deployment target identified
evidence: compose.yaml — services api, db, prometheus, grafana
controls.impact: If not met: The supplied deployment config does not parse, or it targets a different service or platform than the one being validated.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: At least one supported platform config is supplied and parses, and it names the service being deployed.

controls.name: Dependencies locked
controls.impact: If not met: A supplied package manifest has no lockfile, or the lockfile is listed in .gitignore.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Every supplied package manifest has a matching committed lockfile.

controls.name: Deploy gated by CI
controls.impact: If not met: The deploy job can run without the build/test jobs succeeding (no needs/if gate, or tests are allowed to fail).
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: The deploy job runs only after build and test jobs succeed.

controls.name: Compose file valid
evidence: compose.yaml — parses; every service has image or build
controls.impact: If not met: The compose file does not parse, or a service has neither image nor build.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: The compose file parses and every service has an image or build.

controls.name: Container images pinned
evidence: compose.yaml — postgres:16.4, prom/prometheus:v2.53.0, grafana/grafana:11.1.0, api built locally
controls.impact: If not met: An image has no tag or uses the latest tag.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Every image reference has an explicit tag other than latest, or a digest.

controls.name: Container health checks
evidence: compose.yaml:14,28 — healthcheck on api and db
controls.impact: If not met: A long-running service has no healthcheck.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Every long-running service defines a healthcheck.

controls.name: Versioned migrations
controls.impact: If not met: Schema is changed outside migrations (e.g. ad-hoc DDL in app startup) or migration ordering conflicts.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Schema changes are in ordered, versioned migration files.

controls.name: Database credentials not hard-coded
controls.impact: If not met: A literal password, key or full connection string with credentials appears in the supplied files.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Database connection settings come from environment variables, secret bindings or a secret manager.

controls.name: Firestore rules not open
controls.impact: Not in scope for this profile or platform.
controls.recommended_verification: None for this profile and platform.

controls.name: Logging enabled for the platform
controls.impact: If not met: Config explicitly disables logging/telemetry for a deployed service.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Logging/telemetry is enabled in config for each identified platform (e.g. wrangler [observability] enabled = true, Vercel log drain, Prometheus scrape, Cloud Logging).

controls.name: Health endpoint defined
controls.impact: If not met: A deployed service has no health or readiness endpoint.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: A health or readiness endpoint is defined for each deployed service.

controls.name: Prometheus monitoring
controls.impact: If not met: Prometheus config is supplied but does not target the deployed services.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: A Prometheus scrape config targets the deployed services.

controls.name: Grafana monitoring
controls.impact: If not met: Grafana provisioning is supplied but has no data source or no dashboard.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Grafana provisioning includes a data source for the Prometheus instance and at least one dashboard.

controls.name: No committed secrets
controls.impact: If not met: A literal credential (API key, token, password, private key) appears in a supplied file or the scan reports a finding.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: A secret scan over the scoped files reports no findings, and no literal credentials appear in the supplied files.

controls.name: Secrets injected at deploy time
controls.impact: If not met: Secrets are set as plain config vars in a committed file, or env files with secrets are committed.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Secrets are referenced from the platform secret store or environment, and local env files are gitignored.

controls.name: Authentication enforced
evidence: api/deps.py:30 — require_user dependency on every non-health router
controls.impact: If not met: A non-public route or tool is reachable without authentication.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Every non-public route or tool passes authentication/authorization before its handler runs.

controls.name: Dependency vulnerability scanning
controls.impact: If not met: Dependency scanning is configured but disabled or set to never fail.
controls.recommended_verification: Re-check: Dependency scanning is configured (e.g. Dependabot, CodeQL, npm audit or pip-audit in CI).
